decisions.reason: Locates the upper-only/lower-only branches emitting foreground only with a stale background left active, prescribes ESC[49m (or explicit background per cell), notes the row-end reset is too late, and ties the mechanism to the outline/Z/heart edge symptoms without blaming artwork or the emulator.

Explains the trailing-space trim and that a narrower frame neither overwrites nor erases surplus columns; proposes full-width rows with default-background padding plus ESC[2K/ESC[K erase and cursor anchoring, keeping SGR controlled.

Identifies the hand-ported tail2 mismatch with 23 changed cells (distinguishing that from the visible shifted cluster), separates data drift from renderer artifacts, explains the different-frame excerpt test gap, and requires all-frame digest comparison against trusted source art with manifest completeness.

Mounted probe hosts never unmount while the planner keeps re-arming referenced setTimeout handles, pinning the event loop; TTY/stdin already keeps the interactive product alive; prescribes timer.unref() on each new timeout so animation continues without pinning probes.

Consolidates background reset, fixed-width/erase, balanced SGR, and source-backed all-frame digests into a renderer checklist; pre-rollout audit covers timers, non-unmounting hosts, and an explicit process-exit/liveness regression.

caps.reason: Advice requires the half-cell background reset, replaces trimming with full-width plus erase, mandates source-backed frame checks, and recommends unref; no emulator blaming.
